name: 陳宥寧
objective:
全球暖化與氣候變遷已對人類社會造成面臨前所未有的挑戰。不論是哪個國家，都遭受其帶來的影響。並且在 IPCC 發布的報告中，諸多科學證據證實氣候變遷已是不可改變的事實，因此為了謀求世界各地環境的永續發展，「減緩」與「調適」是現階段全球順應氣候變遷積極採取的方式。在聯合國報告中曾經指出我國臺灣舉凡環境及氣候條件隸屬於氣候變遷高危險群，極端氣候事件，例如熱浪、颱風、洪水… 等皆逐漸嚴重影響我們的家園，因此，防減災與氣候變遷調適相對更加重要。其中氣候變遷調適更是能夠面對未來氣候可能產生的衝擊，透過周延的規畫以適應充滿挑戰與變化的新環境。因此本課程針對國際與我國減少災害風險與氣候變遷調適介紹，並探討其各中因應方式與困境等課題，期藉培養與提高對氣候變遷防減災與氣候變遷調適的認識。
Global warming and climate change are the biggest challenges to human society. With current warming trend proceeds at an unprecedented rate, climate change poses a threat to all countries. In the IPCC assessment reports, much of scientific evidence indicates climate change an unalterable fact, so in order to meet the needs of present generations without jeopardizing the ability of futures generations to meet their own need, approaches on "mitigation" and "adaptation" needed to be adopted in response to climate change. 
Taiwan is vulnerable and at high risk to climate change because of geographic exposure and climatic conditions. Extreme weather events, such as heat wave, typhoon, and flood, bring catastrophic damages in Taiwan. Hence, proper climate change adaptation and disaster risk reduction measures needed to be taken proactively to reduce many of the adverse impacts and to enhance beneficial impacts. schedule:
Week 1~6：Dr. Tseng

Week 7：國際氣候 AI、災害 AI 與責任 AI 治理趨勢
Global Trends in Climate AI, Disaster AI and Responsible AI Governance

Week8：AI 天氣預報、災害預警與災害監測工具 
AI Weather Forecasting, Disaster Early Warning and Monitoring Tools

Week 9：期中考試 (Dr. Tseng)
Midterm Examination (Dr. Tseng)

Week 10：氣候資料、升溫情境與調適需求判讀
Climate Data, Warming Scenarios and Adaptation Needs

Week 11：Google Earth Engine 與 UN - SPIDER 淹水範圍判釋
Google Earth Engine and UN - SPIDER Flood Mapping

Week 12：QGIS、都市熱島、NDVI 與綠覆率調適分析
QGIS, Urban Heat Island, NDVI and Green Coverage Analysis

Week 13：AI 機器學習入門：災害脆弱度分群與影像辨識
Introductory AI: Vulnerability Clustering and Disaster Image Classification

Week 14：水風險、企業氣候風險與 AI 排放追蹤
Water Risk, Corporate Climate Risk and AI-based Emissions Tracking

Week 15：氣候 AI、災害 AI 與調適 AI 整合討論
Integration of Climate AI, Disaster AI and Adaptation AI

Week 16：聖誕節／國定假日
Christmas / National Holiday

Week 17：元旦／國定假日
New Year’s Day / National Holiday

Week 18：期末考試
Final Examination
scorePolicy:
出席狀況：10%
個人作業：60%
期末考試：30%
materials:
教師自編教材
Birkmann, J. (Ed.). (2013). Measuring Vulnerability to Natural Hazards: Towards Disaster Resilient Societies (2nd ed.). United Nations University Press.
Longley, P. A., Goodchild, M. F., Maguire, D. J., & Rhind, D. W. (2015). Geographic Information Science and Systems (4th ed.). Wiley.
Dignum, V. (2019). Responsible Artificial Intelligence: How to Develop and Use AI in a Responsible Way. Springer.
Dale, L. (2022). Climate Change Adaptation: An Earth Institute Sustainability Primer. Columbia University Press.
Cardille, J. A., Crowley, M. A., Saah, D., & Clinton, N. E. (Eds.). (2024). Cloud-Based Remote Sensing with Google Earth Engine: Fundamentals and Applications. Springer.
延伸教學與資源: ● 數位科技融入 (Digital Technology Integration) 運用生成式 AI、VR/AR、IoT、IRS 等新興科技輔助教學與評量。Utilizes emerging technologies such as Generative AI, VR/AR, IoT, and IRS (Interactive Response Systems) to facilitate teaching and assessment.● 數位教材資源應用 (Application of Digital Resources) 採用影音多媒體或具開放授權之資源（如 OCW、開放教科書）作為主要或輔助教材。Adopts multimedia or open-licensed resources (e.g., OCW, Open Textbooks) as primary or supplementary teaching materials.
課程對應SDGs指標: SDG4：優質教育（Quality Education）SDG6：潔淨水與衛生（Clean Water and Sanitation）SDG9：產業創新與基礎設施（Industry, Innovation and Infrastructure）SDG11：永續城市與社區（Sustainable Cities and Communities）SDG13：氣候行動（Climate Action）SDG15：陸域生命（Life on Land）SDG16：和平正義與有力的制度（Peace, Justice and Strong Institutions）
課程是否導入AI: ● 使用生成式 AI 作為教學過程的輔助工具（Use generative AI tools as an aid to the teaching process）● 鼓勵學生使用生成式 AI 工具（Encourage students to use generative AI tools）● 簡單介紹 AI 的基本概念（Briefly introduce the basic concept of AI）
remarks: 本課程導入 AI 輔助學習與開放資料工具，包含生成式 AI、氣候 AI、災害 AI、調適 AI、GIS、遙測與氣候資料平台等。修課同學可於課堂實作與個人作業中使用 AI 工具輔助資料蒐集、案例分析、圖資判讀與文字整理，但不得直接複製 AI 產出作為個人作業答案。所有 AI 產出均須進行原始資料查證、人工判斷與必要修正，並於作業中註明使用之工具、資料來源、操作方式及 AI 可能產生之限制或錯誤。本課程亦將說明 AI 幻覺、資料偏誤、模型不確定性、可解釋性、公平性、問責性與責任 AI 治理等議題。當日無法到課請記得事先跟 Dr. Amy Chen 或助教請假。每次個人作業請記得如期繳交。
